release_notes: Fixes the MCP connector returning 0 tools. mcp.php read tools.json with json_decode(..., true), which turns an empty {} into an empty PHP array, and json_encode turns an empty PHP array back into "[]" instead of "{}". So every parameter-less tool served "properties":[] / "additionalProperties":[], which the MCP spec defines as records, and the client rejected the whole tools/list with "expected record, received array". inputSchema is now normalised at load time: properties/patternProperties/$defs become {}, array-valued additionalProperties becomes true — the fix holds regardless of which tools.json revision is deployed. Also fixes the bot panel: 0.9.6.2 rewrote the request-body helper so it recursed on itself instead of reading php://input, so every POST (login, bot lists, every save) spun until the PHP-FPM worker died and nginx answered 503. On top of that the bot IP table rendered blank rows — the panel read item.value while the column is ip_or_cidr — and lists were fetched flat (first 1000 only), so anything past row 1000 was invisible and impossible to delete. The IP table now has a search box, a shown-of-total counter and load-more, and lists are searched and paged in SQL. Finally, 39 missing i18n keys were rendering as raw key names across the panel (bot list keys had landed in the wrong locale section, and the payout-model dropdown, campaign parameters, stream device types, all 15 admin tile descriptions and six common labels had no translation at all) — added across all seven locales.
